product_category.value: AI-driven virtual patient simulation for healthcare education (Spark), plus AI voice add-ons for physical patient simulators (SimVox, ALEX).

evidence.quote: PCS Spark is an AI-driven virtual healthcare simulation platform designed to enhance the clinical skills training experience for medical and nursing schools.
SimVox is an AI-driven smart speaker designed to enhance your existing simulation manikins, bringing them to life with interactive, voice-enabled capabilities.
PCS Spark is available in both a cloud screen-based experience, and virtual reality headset formats.
ALEX is a high-fidelity simulator with seamlessly integrated AI to enable realistic, interactive patient communication.

platforms.note: Web is based on 'cloud screen-based experience'; no browser is named. Physical hardware covers SimVox (a smart speaker added to existing manikins) and ALEX (a high-fidelity simulator). No headset brand is named.
